notes.title: Update V0.2
notes.content:
PATCH NOTES Version .02
-Removed mannequins
+Fixed the error where the cursor would disappear 
+Added Lanterns to all of the houses
+Fixed the time of the exorcism finisher text
Fixed Batteries
+added more environmental detail
+Fixed some optimizations issues
+Fixed error where cassette would play every time you push use
+Added a couple more batteries and other resources around
+Added Moon to cemetery
+Added a new Journal texture in the inventory
General bug fixes
+Redid the starting lobby
+Added some ghost AI
